candidates.name: Lazy exact delay-law batches
candidates.representation: one batch per current release; Arc original law plus shared delay-sorted original-index permutation; cursor per batch
critical_conditions: Select due atoms by original f64 predicate; emit newly due indices in original atom order and batches in original append order.
Preserve f64 association, parent pre-tick eligibility, completion clock and egress-before-internal order.
Version checkpoint representation; preserve last committed rollback state.
Report logical atoms separately from physical batches/bytes.

candidates.name: Immutable release chunks with an exact due index
critical_conditions: Wheel only indexes candidate batches; no rounding or clamping timestamps.
Restore original batch/atom order before physical updates.
Handle long-delay overflow and partial consumption.
Scheduling acceleration is not logical event compression.

counterexamples.claim_rejected: Stop a cursor at the first not-yet-due atom in the original law.
Total mass and first birth moment suffice to preserve delayed arrivals.
